description: 1. Run `python3 scripts/parse_health.py data/raw/export.zip /tmp/chart_data.json` to stream-parse the Apple Health XML and produce monthly aggregated metrics. 2. Construct the user profile: gender=female, age=34, height=165cm, weight_unit=lb (CRITICAL: Apple Health stores body mass in lb by default — agent must pass --weight-unit lb, not kg), conditions=hyperthyroidism (must pass --conditions flag so the thyroid adjustment banner appears), activity=active (must use the exact enum 'active', not 'regular' or 'workout'). 3. Apply the correct dynamic reference ranges: female age 34 maps to the '26-35' RHR bracket (excellent<55, good≤61, normal≤74, high≤83); HRV maps to the '30-40' age bracket (low<20, normal 20-45, good>45); VO2Max maps to female '30-39' bracket (poor<28, fair≥28, good≥33, excellent≥41, elite≥46); activity=active → steps target 10000. 4. Run `python3 scripts/generate_report.py /tmp/chart_data.json health_report.html --gender female --age 34 --height 165 --weight-unit lb --conditions hyperthyroidism --activity active --verdict '...'`. 5. The resulting HTML must contain: correct RHR bracket values (55, 61), correct HRV bracket values (20, 45), correct VO2Max bracket values (28, 33), the 'lb' weight unit annotation, thyroid condition reference, steps target 10000, and a verdict section.
